resources.string: For the weather, the phone\'s rough place (rounded to 0.1 degree, about 10 km) goes to api.open-meteo.com, at most every 30 minutes.
For the weather, the place of the chosen city goes to api.open-meteo.com, at most every 30 minutes. This also happens when \"Use the phone\'s location\" is off.
Leaves the phone for the watch: only the weather, not the place.
Without a place there is no weather on the watch face. Turn on the phone\'s location, or choose a city.
Leaves the phone: its rough place, rounded to 0.1 degree (about 10 km), each time the data goes to the watch. Only while the watch face needs it.
